kural:1.label: M
kural:1.meaning: The letter 'A' is first, and God is first for the world.

kural:2.label: N
kural:2.meaning: Education is useless if one does not worship the all-knowing God.

kural:3.label: M
kural:3.meaning: Those who reach the feet of God live long on earth.

kural:4.label: N
kural:4.meaning: Those who cling to God's feet have no distress anywhere.

kural:5.label: N
kural:5.meaning: Praising God frees one from good and evil actions.

kural:6.label: N
kural:6.meaning: Those who conquer the five senses live long.

kural:7.label: N
kural:7.meaning: Mental anxiety can only be removed by following the incomparable God.

kural:8.label: M
kural:8.meaning: One can cross the sea of births only by praising God.

kural:9.label: N
kural:9.meaning: Heads that do not bow to God are as useless as numb senses.

kural:10.label: M
kural:10.meaning: Only those who reach God's feet swim the ocean of births.

kural:11.label: L
kural:11.meaning: Rain sustains the world, hence it is considered nectar.

kural:12.label: L
kural:12.meaning: Rain provides both food and drink for living beings.

kural:13.label: L
kural:13.meaning: If rain fails, hunger torments the vast sea-girt world.

kural:14.label: L
kural:14.meaning: Farmers cannot plough if clouds fail to yield rain.

kural:15.label: L
kural:15.meaning: Rain can ruin, but it alone restores life.

kural:16.label: L
kural:16.meaning: Green grass cannot sprout without falling raindrops from the sky.

kural:17.label: L
kural:17.science_concept: Water cycle connecting ocean and clouds
kural:17.meaning: Even the vast ocean loses its volume if clouds fail to return water.

kural:18.label: L
kural:18.meaning: Festivals and worship cease if the sky dries up.

kural:19.label: L
kural:19.science_concept: Rain sustains human virtue and charity
kural:19.meaning: Charity and penance fail in the world if rain stops.

kural:20.label: L
kural:20.science_concept: Water is essential for life and conduct
kural:20.meaning: Water sustains life and proper conduct depends entirely on rain.

kural:21.label: N
kural:21.meaning: Praising the greatness of ascetics who renounce worldly attachments.

kural:22.label: N
kural:22.meaning: Measuring the greatness of ascetics is like counting the dead.

kural:23.label: N
kural:23.meaning: The greatness of those who follow virtue shines above all.

kural:24.label: N
kural:24.meaning: He who controls the five senses is a seed for heaven.

kural:25.label: N
kural:25.meaning: Indra is witness to the power of those who have subdued their five senses.

kural:26.label: N
kural:26.meaning: Great men achieve difficult tasks, whereas small men do not.

kural:27.label: L
kural:27.science_concept: Five sensory perceptions of the material world
kural:27.meaning: The world is bound to those who understand the five sensory experiences.

kural:28.label: N
kural:28.meaning: The greatness of accomplished sages is revealed through their words.

kural:29.label: M
kural:29.meaning: The fleeting anger of those who have attained the mountain of virtue is hard to endure.

kural:30.label: N
kural:30.meaning: True ascetics are those who practice gentle kindness toward all living beings.

kural:31.label: N
kural:31.meaning: Virtue yields distinction and wealth; what greater benefit can there be?

kural:32.label: N
kural:32.meaning: There is no greater gain than virtue, and no greater ruin than forgetting it.

kural:33.label: N
kural:33.meaning: Perform righteous deeds constantly and by every means possible.

kural:34.label: N
kural:34.meaning: Virtue is having a spotless mind; all else is mere show.

kural:35.label: N
kural:35.meaning: Virtue consists of avoiding envy, desire, anger, and harsh words.

kural:36.label: N
kural:36.meaning: Do not delay virtue thinking you will learn later; it is an undying support at death.

kural:37.label: N
kural:37.meaning: Litter-bearer and rider illustrate the inequality of past karma through social status.

kural:38.label: N
kural:38.meaning: Doing good deeds repeatedly blocks the path of future rebirth and pain.

kural:39.label: N
kural:39.meaning: True happiness arises only from virtuous acts; everything else lacks fame and joy.

kural:40.label: N
kural:40.meaning: Worthy acts constitute virtue, whereas vice is the blame one must shun.

kural:41.label: N
kural:41.meaning: The ideal householder supports the three orders of righteous life properly.

kural:42.label: N
kural:42.meaning: The householder supports ascetics, the destitute, and dependent relatives.

kural:43.label: N
kural:43.meaning: Serving manes, gods, guests, kin, and oneself is the prime duty.

kural:44.label: N
kural:44.meaning: Sharing food without sin ensures the family line never fails.

kural:45.label: N
kural:45.meaning: A home possessing love and virtue fulfills the true nature of life.

kural:46.label: N
kural:46.meaning: What more can one gain by leaving a righteous household life?

kural:47.label: N
kural:47.meaning: He who lives a natural householder's life excels all spiritual strivers.

kural:48.label: N
kural:48.meaning: A righteous householder possesses greater ascetic power than fasting monks.

kural:49.label: N
kural:49.meaning: Home-life and virtue are identical if free from faults.

kural:50.label: N
kural:50.meaning: He who lives righteously on earth is regarded as a god.

kural:51.label: N
kural:51.meaning: A good housewife possesses noble qualities and spends thriftily.

kural:52.label: N
kural:52.meaning: A home without a chaste wife lacks true greatness.

kural:53.label: N
kural:53.meaning: Nothing is lacking if the wife is virtuous.

kural:54.label: N
kural:54.meaning: There is no greater treasure than a chaste woman.

kural:55.label: O
kural:55.meaning: A devoted wife who worships her husband commands rain to fall.

kural:56.label: N
kural:56.meaning: A virtuous woman guards herself, protects her husband, and maintains her reputation.

kural:57.label: N
kural:57.meaning: Physical guards are useless; self-control is a woman's best protection.

kural:58.label: N
kural:58.meaning: Virtuous women attain the heavenly world of the gods.

kural:59.label: O
kural:59.meaning: Men without noble wives lack the proud, lion-like gait before detractors.

kural:60.label: N
kural:60.meaning: A noble wife is home's blessing, and good children are its jewels.

kural:61.label: N
kural:61.meaning: Having wise children is the greatest bliss in the world.

kural:62.label: N
kural:62.meaning: Flawless and virtuous children prevent any evil from touching one.

kural:63.label: N
kural:63.meaning: Children are true wealth, earned through one's past actions.

kural:64.label: M
kural:64.meaning: Food stirred by children's hands is sweeter than nectar.

kural:65.label: N
kural:65.meaning: Touching children pleases the body; hearing their words pleases the ears.

kural:66.label: N
kural:66.meaning: Those who haven't heard their children's babble call the flute and lute sweet.

kural:67.label: N
kural:67.meaning: A father's gratitude to his son is to seat him foremost in assemblies.

kural:68.label: N
kural:68.meaning: Children's wisdom is pleasing to all living beings on earth.

kural:69.label: N
kural:69.meaning: A mother rejoices more on hearing her son is wise than at birth.

kural:70.label: N
kural:70.meaning: A son's service is making people ask what penance earned such a father.

kural:71.label: L
kural:71.meaning: True love cannot be locked away; the tears of the loving reveal it.

kural:72.label: N
kural:72.meaning: The loveless claim everything for themselves; the loving give even their bones to others.

kural:74.label: N
kural:74.meaning: Love generates deep affection and friendship.

kural:75.label: N
kural:75.meaning: Love brings supreme joy to life.

kural:76.label: N
kural:76.meaning: Love supports virtue and opposes cruelty.

kural:77.label: O
kural:77.meaning: Justice burns the loveless like solar heat on boneless creatures.

kural:78.label: O
kural:78.meaning: Loveless life is like a dead tree blooming in a desert.

kural:79.label: N
kural:79.meaning: Outer limbs are useless without internal love.

kural:80.label: N
kural:80.meaning: Loveless bodies are merely skin and bone.

kural:81.label: N
kural:81.meaning: Household life exists to host guests.

kural:82.label: N
kural:82.meaning: Eating alone while ignoring guests is undesirable.

kural:83.label: N
kural:83.meaning: The life of one who hosts daily never ruins.

kural:84.label: N
kural:84.meaning: Wealth resides where guests are warmly welcomed.

kural:85.label: N
kural:85.meaning: Hospitality and farming metaphors regarding guests and fields.

kural:86.label: N
kural:86.meaning: Spiritual reward in heaven for hosting guests.

kural:88.label: N
kural:88.meaning: Regret of those who fail to practice hospitality.

kural:89.label: N
kural:89.meaning: Failing to feed guests is true poverty.

kural:90.label: O
kural:90.meaning: Anicham flower withers when smelled, just like guests wither at cold looks.

kural:91.label: N
kural:91.meaning: The truthful and sweet words of sages.

kural:92.label: N
kural:92.meaning: The value of smiling and sweet words.

kural:93.label: N
kural:93.meaning: Gracious virtue consists of pleasant looks and sincere sweet words.

kural:94.label: N
kural:94.meaning: Poverty disappears for those who speak kindly to everyone.

kural:95.label: N
kural:95.meaning: Humility and sweet speech are the true ornaments for a person.

kural:96.label: N
kural:96.meaning: Speaking good and sweet words destroys sins and increases virtue.

kural:97.label: N
kural:97.meaning: Courteous and kindly words lead to goodness and graceful deeds.

kural:98.label: N
kural:98.meaning: Kind words free from meanness bring joy to this and future lives.

kural:99.label: N
kural:99.meaning: Who would use harsh words after witnessing the sweetness of kind words?

kural:100.label: O
kural:100.science_concept: eating raw fruit instead of ripe fruit
kural:100.meaning: Speaking harsh words when sweet ones exist is like leaving ripe fruits for raw ones.

kural:101.label: M
kural:101.meaning: Unsolicited help is so valuable that earth and heaven cannot repay it.

kural:102.label: M
kural:102.meaning: Help given at the right time is greater than the world.

kural:103.label: O
kural:103.meaning: Help given without expecting return is greater than the sea.

kural:104.label: O
kural:104.science_concept: millet seed and palm tree scale difference
kural:104.meaning: Wise people value a tiny millet-sized help as tall as a palm tree.

kural:105.label: N
kural:105.meaning: The value of help depends on the worth of the receiver.

kural:106.label: N
kural:106.meaning: Never forget the friendship of the pure and helpful.

kural:107.label: N
kural:107.meaning: One should remember helpful friends across sevenfold births.

kural:108.label: N
kural:108.meaning: Forget not good turns; immediately forget wrongs done.

kural:109.label: N
kural:109.meaning: Let deadly harms be forgotten while remembering one good-turn.

kural:110.label: N
kural:110.meaning: The virtue-killer may be saved, but not the benefit-killer.

kural:111.label: N
kural:111.meaning: Equity is supreme virtue, giving each man his due.

kural:112.label: N
kural:112.meaning: Wealth of the equitable man grows and lasts to posterity.

kural:113.label: N
kural:113.meaning: Though profitable, turn away from unjust gains without delay.

kural:114.label: N
kural:114.meaning: The worthy and unworthy are seen in their posterity.

kural:115.label: N
kural:115.meaning: Loss and gain arise naturally; an equal mind adorns the wise.

kural:116.label: N
kural:116.meaning: Be sure of perdition if you leave justice for sinful lures.

kural:117.label: N
kural:117.meaning: The just reduced to poverty is not degraded by equity.

kural:118.label: O
kural:118.meaning: Like a balance holding equal scales, a poised mind is wise.

kural:119.label: N
kural:119.meaning: Justice is upright, unbending, and free from crooked words.

kural:120.label: N
kural:120.meaning: A trader's business prospers when his dealings are fair.

kural:121.label: N
kural:121.meaning: Self-control leads to divine realms, while indulgence leads to ruin.

kural:122.label: N
kural:122.meaning: Guard self-control as the greatest treasure for human life.

kural:123.label: N
kural:123.meaning: Living with controlled wisdom brings lasting fame and honor.

kural:124.label: O
kural:124.meaning: A steadfast sage appears even more magnificent than a towering mountain.

kural:125.label: N
kural:125.meaning: Humility is good for everyone, but it is especially fitting for the rich.

kural:126.label: O
kural:126.meaning: Like a tortoise retracting five limbs, controlling five senses ensures lasting happiness.

kural:127.label: N
kural:127.meaning: Guard your tongue carefully, or careless speech will bring misery.

kural:128.label: N
kural:128.meaning: Even a single cruel word spoken will ruin all previous goodness.

kural:129.label: L
kural:129.science_concept: burn injury healing vs psychological hurt
kural:129.meaning: Wounds caused by fire heal physically, but emotional wounds from harsh words never heal.

kural:130.label: N
kural:130.meaning: Virtue patiently seeks out the learned person who controls their anger.

kural:131.label: N
kural:131.meaning: Since proper conduct brings distinction, it must be protected more than life itself.

kural:132.label: N
kural:132.meaning: Examine and guard proper conduct carefully, for it is the truest support.

kural:133.label: N
kural:133.meaning: Good conduct denotes high birth, while bad conduct indicates a low birth.

kural:134.label: N
kural:134.meaning: Forgotten learning can be relearned, but lost moral conduct is permanently ruined.

kural:135.label: N
kural:135.meaning: Prosperity may visit the envious, but true elevation never belongs to the ill-behaved.

kural:136.label: N
kural:136.meaning: The steadfast never swerve from moral conduct, knowing the evils brought by transgression.

kural:137.label: N
kural:137.meaning: Good conduct leads to nobility, whereas bad conduct brings unmitigated disgrace.

kural:138.label: N
kural:138.meaning: Virtuous conduct is the seed of goodness, while evil conduct continually brings suffering.

kural:139.label: N
kural:139.meaning: Righteous men will not utter evil words even by mistake.

kural:140.label: N
kural:140.meaning: Though widely read, those who live out of harmony with the world are ignorant.

kural:141.label: N
kural:141.meaning: Those who understand virtue and wealth do not desire another man's wife.

kural:142.label: N
kural:142.meaning: Among transgressors of virtue, none is more foolish than the adulterer.

kural:143.label: N
kural:143.meaning: Those who wrong trusted friends' wives are no different from the dead.

kural:144.label: N
kural:144.meaning: Greatness matters little if one lusts after another's wife even in the smallest measure.

kural:145.label: N
kural:145.meaning: Guilt and enduring disgrace result from trespassing on another's wife.

kural:146.label: N
kural:146.meaning: Hatred, sin, fear, and shame permanently attach to adulterers.

kural:147.label: N
kural:147.meaning: The truly righteous householder never desires another man's wife.

kural:148.label: N
kural:148.meaning: Men of noble character do not look at another's wife with desire.

kural:149.label: N
kural:149.meaning: Virtuous are those who avoid other men's wives in this ocean-bound earth.

kural:150.label: N
kural:150.meaning: Even sinners should refrain from desiring another man's wife.

kural:151.label: O
kural:151.meaning: Just as the earth bears those who dig it, bear with those who revile you.

kural:152.label: N
kural:152.meaning: Forgiving insults is good, but forgetting them entirely is even better.

kural:153.label: N
kural:153.meaning: Neglecting guests is poverty, while enduring fools is true inner strength.

kural:154.label: N
kural:154.meaning: Cultivating patience and endurance preserves one's integrity and character.

kural:155.label: M
kural:155.meaning: Those who exact revenge are dismissed, while the patient are treasured like gold.

kural:156.label: N
kural:156.meaning: Revenge brings only a day of joy, but patience yields everlasting praise.

kural:157.label: N
kural:157.meaning: Do not retaliate when harmed; refrain from unjust actions.

kural:158.label: N
kural:158.meaning: Vanquish the proud who cause you anguish through your own noble character.

kural:159.label: N
kural:159.meaning: Those who meekly endure bitter words are purer than ascetics.

kural:160.label: N
kural:160.meaning: Those who fast are great, but greater are they who bear insults.

kural:161.label: N
kural:161.meaning: Consider your heart virtuous when your nature is free from jealousy.

kural:162.label: N
kural:162.meaning: No excellence surpasses the achievement of having an envy-free nature.

kural:163.label: N
kural:163.meaning: He who envies others' good fortune will not prosper in virtue.

kural:164.label: N
kural:164.meaning: The wise do not wrong others through envy, knowing evils bring ruin.

kural:165.label: N
kural:165.meaning: Envy alone is sufficient to ruin a man even without enemies.

kural:166.label: N
kural:166.meaning: The family of one who envies charitable gifts will perish without food and clothes.

kural:167.label: N
kural:167.meaning: Goddess of fortune leaves the envious person to misfortune.

kural:168.label: N
kural:168.meaning: Envy destroys wealth and drags a person into evil paths.

kural:169.label: N
kural:169.meaning: Why envious people are rich and good people poor puzzles observers.

kural:170.label: N
kural:170.meaning: The envious never truly prosper, and the envyless never fail to prosper.

kural:171.label: N
kural:171.meaning: Unjustly coveting wealth ruins a family and brings immediate crime.

kural:172.label: N
kural:172.meaning: Those ashamed of sin refrain from coveting what brings ruin.

kural:173.label: N
kural:173.meaning: Those seeking higher bliss do not commit wrong for fleeting pleasures.

kural:174.label: N
kural:174.meaning: Wise self-controllers never covet the property of others even in poverty.

kural:175.label: N
kural:175.meaning: What is subtle wisdom worth if one acts wrongfully toward others?

kural:176.label: N
kural:176.meaning: One seeking grace who plots for others' wealth will surely perish.

kural:177.label: N
kural:177.meaning: Shun the acquisition born of covetousness, for its yield is harmful.

kural:178.label: N
kural:178.meaning: The surest way to preserve wealth is not to covet others' property.

kural:179.label: N
kural:179.meaning: Fortune naturally seeks the just and wise who do not covet.

kural:180.label: N
kural:180.meaning: Mindless coveting brings ruin, while freedom from desire brings greatness.

kural:181.label: N
kural:181.meaning: Avoiding slander is praised even if other virtues are neglected.

kural:182.label: N
kural:182.meaning: Backbiting and false smiles are worse than open transgressions.

kural:183.label: N
kural:183.meaning: Death is preferable to living by backbiting and deceit.

kural:184.label: N
kural:184.meaning: Harsh words to one's face are better than malicious gossip behind.

kural:185.label: N
kural:185.meaning: A slanderer shows he lacks true virtue in his heart.

kural:186.label: N
kural:186.meaning: One who exposes others' faults will have his own exposed.

kural:187.label: N
kural:187.meaning: Those who cannot win friends with pleasant words create enmity.

kural:188.label: N
kural:188.meaning: Those who expose friends' faults will do worse to strangers.

kural:189.label: N
kural:189.meaning: The earth bears the heavy burden of those who speak evil.

kural:190.label: N
kural:190.meaning: No harm would come if everyone examined their own defects.

kural:191.label: N
kural:191.meaning: One who speaks useless words in public is despised by all.

kural:192.label: N
kural:192.meaning: Vain talk before many is worse than harming trusted friends.

kural:193.label: N
kural:193.meaning: Idle and useless words reveal a person's lack of good character.

kural:194.label: N
kural:194.meaning: Useless and ungracious words spoken in public destroy all goodness and gains.

kural:195.label: N
kural:195.meaning: Glory and distinction depart when people of good character speak worthless words.

kural:196.label: N
kural:196.meaning: A person who prides himself in useless words is considered human chaff.

kural:197.label: N
kural:197.meaning: Wise individuals should refrain from uttering any useless words.

kural:198.label: N
kural:198.meaning: The wise, capable of evaluating deep meanings, never speak words without value.

kural:199.label: N
kural:199.meaning: Flawless wise individuals never utter meaningless words, even out of forgetfulness.

kural:200.label: N
kural:200.meaning: Speak only fruitful words and never utter useless, fruitless ones.

kural:201.label: N
kural:201.meaning: The wicked fear not sin, but the noble dread the arrogant pride of doing evil.

kural:202.label: L
kural:202.meaning: Since evil causes terrible harm, fear evil more than physical fire.

kural:203.label: N
kural:203.meaning: The highest wisdom is not to inflict harm even upon one's enemies.

kural:204.label: N
kural:204.meaning: Never plot the ruin of others; virtue itself will ruin the plotter.

kural:205.label: N
kural:205.meaning: Do not commit evil due to poverty; doing so leads to greater destitution.

kural:206.label: N
kural:206.meaning: Do not inflict evil on others if you wish to avoid suffering.

kural:207.label: N
kural:207.meaning: Enemies may be escaped, but the consequences of bad deeds will follow and destroy.

kural:208.label: O
kural:208.meaning: Ruin follows wrongdoers just as a shadow invariably clings to its object.

kural:209.label: N
kural:209.meaning: He who loves himself should never commit even the slightest evil deed.

kural:210.label: N
kural:210.meaning: He who avoids straying into evil is known as one secure from ruin.

kural:211.label: L
kural:211.science_concept: rain's role and unrequited natural utility
kural:211.meaning: True duty seeks no return; what can the world give back to rain?

kural:212.label: N
kural:212.meaning: All wealth acquired through hard work is meant to help the deserving.

kural:213.label: N
kural:213.meaning: It is hard to find a greater good than helpfulness in heaven or earth.

kural:214.label: N
kural:214.meaning: He truly lives who acts with proper kindness; others are considered dead.

kural:215.label: O
kural:215.meaning: The wealth of the wise and benevolent is like a water-filled village pond.

kural:216.label: O
kural:216.meaning: Wealth acquired by the righteous is like a fruit tree laden in a village.

kural:217.label: O
kural:217.meaning: Wealth of a charitable man is compared to a healing medicinal tree.

kural:218.label: N
kural:218.meaning: Wise people do not shirk their duty even during hard times.

kural:219.label: N
kural:219.meaning: The grief of a benevolent person is the inability to give relief.

kural:220.label: N
kural:220.meaning: Even if ruin comes from benevolence, it is worth selling oneself to acquire.

kural:221.label: N
kural:221.meaning: True charity is giving to the poor; everything else is expecting a return.

kural:222.label: N
kural:222.meaning: Begging is bad even if from good people; giving is good even without heaven.

kural:223.label: N
kural:223.meaning: Giving without waiting for a plea marks a noble birth.

kural:224.label: N
kural:224.meaning: Begging is painful until the requester sees the joyful face of the giver.

kural:225.label: N
kural:225.meaning: The power that cures hunger is greater than the power of enduring ascetic penance.

kural:226.label: N
kural:226.meaning: Relieving the hunger of the destitute is the true treasury for one's wealth.

kural:227.label: O
kural:227.meaning: Hunger is described as a burning disease that cannot touch one who shares food.

kural:228.label: N
kural:228.meaning: Hard-hearted misers who hoard wealth do not know the joy of giving.

kural:229.label: N
kural:229.meaning: Eating alone what one has gathered is worse than begging.

kural:230.label: N
kural:230.meaning: Nothing is more painful than death, except the inability to give.

kural:231.label: N
kural:231.meaning: Giving to gain fame is the greatest asset for a soul.

kural:232.label: N
kural:232.meaning: All praises spoken are focused on those who give to the needy.

kural:233.label: N
kural:233.meaning: Nothing else stands undestroyed in this world except supreme fame.

kural:234.label: N
kural:234.meaning: Celestial worlds praise those who achieve lasting fame on earth.

kural:235.label: N
kural:235.meaning: Understanding ruin as growth and death as life is rare.

kural:236.label: N
kural:236.meaning: If born, be born with fame; otherwise, not being born is better.

kural:237.label: N
kural:237.meaning: Blame those who fail to live with fame, not those who scold them.

kural:238.label: N
kural:238.meaning: Failing to leave behind fame is considered a disgrace on earth.

kural:239.label: L
kural:239.meaning: The earth burdened by infamous people will decrease in its yield.

kural:240.label: N
kural:240.meaning: Only those live who live without blemish; others are not truly alive.

kural:241.label: N
kural:241.meaning: Grace is the highest form of wealth, superior to material possessions.

kural:242.label: N
kural:242.meaning: Examine and practice compassion by all means; it is the ultimate support.

kural:243.label: N
kural:243.meaning: Those with compassionate hearts will not enter dark, miserable worlds.

kural:244.label: N
kural:244.meaning: Those who protect living beings and show mercy fear no karmic sins.

kural:245.label: O
kural:245.meaning: The wide, wind-nourished earth bears witness that merciful people face no sorrow.

kural:246.label: N
kural:246.meaning: Those who abandon grace and do evil are considered thoughtless and ruined.

kural:247.label: N
kural:247.meaning: Just as the wealthless lack this world, the graceless lack the next world.

kural:248.label: N
kural:248.meaning: The poor may prosper later, but the graceless will never truly flourish.

kural:249.label: N
kural:249.meaning: Virtue by the graceless is like misunderstanding the true nature of reality.

kural:250.label: N
kural:250.meaning: Consider your weakness before the strong when you oppress the feeble.

kural:251.label: N
kural:251.meaning: How can one show grace who eats another creature's flesh to fatten his own?

kural:252.label: N
kural:252.meaning: The thriftless lack wealth, and meat-eaters lack true compassion.

kural:253.label: N
kural:253.meaning: Compares heartlessness of weapon-wielder and meat-eater.

kural:254.label: N
kural:254.meaning: Declares killing and eating meat as unrighteous.

kural:255.label: N
kural:255.meaning: Abstaining from meat saves life and prevents hell.

kural:256.label: N
kural:256.meaning: Meat trade would cease if people stopped eating flesh.

kural:257.label: N
kural:257.meaning: One should avoid meat realizing it is another's wound.

kural:258.label: N
kural:258.meaning: Wise men freed from illusion refuse to eat dead flesh.

kural:259.label: N
kural:259.meaning: Not killing and eating is better than thousand sacrifices.

kural:260.label: N
kural:260.meaning: All living beings worship those who do not eat meat.

kural:261.label: N
kural:261.meaning: Enduring pain and harming no life constitute true penance.

kural:262.label: N
kural:262.meaning: Penance suits the penitent, not the untrained pretender.

kural:263.label: N
kural:263.meaning: Others practice penance to support the true ascetics.

kural:264.label: N
kural:264.meaning: Through penance one gains power to protect or destroy.

kural:265.label: N
kural:265.meaning: Penance is practiced because it grants all desired wishes.

kural:266.label: N
kural:266.meaning: Those who perform penance achieve their goal; others are ruined by desire.

kural:267.label: O
kural:267.meaning: Just as gold shines brighter when heated in fire, suffering refines ascetics.

kural:268.label: N
kural:268.meaning: All living souls worship him who has fully conquered his own soul.

kural:269.label: N
kural:269.meaning: Those who attain the power of penance can even conquer death.

kural:270.label: N
kural:270.meaning: The reason many are poor is that those who do penance are few.

kural:271.label: M
kural:271.meaning: The five natural elements inside laugh at the deceitful hypocrisy of a sly man.

kural:272.label: N
kural:272.meaning: Of what use are lofty ascetic appearances if one's conscience accuses them?

kural:273.label: O
kural:273.meaning: Feigning strength while weak is like a cow grazing covered in a tiger skin.

kural:274.label: O
kural:274.meaning: Committing sins in saintly disguise is like a fowler hiding to catch birds.

kural:275.label: N
kural:275.meaning: False asceticism brings manifold miseries and endless regrets.

kural:276.label: N
kural:276.meaning: There are no harder-hearted people than those who deceitfully pretend to have renounced the world.

kural:277.label: N
kural:277.meaning: Hypocritical people resemble red-and-black jequirity seeds, appearing good outside but dark inside.

kural:278.label: N
kural:278.meaning: Bathing in holy waters cannot cleanse those whose minds remain impure with hidden sins.

kural:279.label: N
kural:279.meaning: Do not judge by appearance; straight arrows kill while curved lutes produce pleasant music.

kural:280.label: N
kural:280.meaning: There is no need to shave the head or grow long hair if one avoids socially condemned actions.

kural:281.label: N
kural:281.meaning: One who desires freedom from reproach must carefully guard his mind against all forms of theft.

kural:282.label: N
kural:282.meaning: Even the mere mental intent to acquire another's wealth through fraud is a grievous sin.

kural:283.label: N
kural:283.meaning: Wealth acquired through fraudulent means may temporarily grow, but it will eventually perish completely.

kural:284.label: N
kural:284.meaning: The intense desire born of theft will ultimately yield unending misery and ruin.

kural:285.label: N
kural:285.meaning: Grace and love are absent in those who patiently wait to steal from the negligent.

kural:286.label: N
kural:286.meaning: Those consumed by a passion for theft fail to live within righteous and measured boundaries.

kural:287.label: N
kural:287.meaning: Wise men who understand limits completely avoid the dark craft and mindset of thievery.

kural:288.label: N
kural:288.meaning: Just as virtue dwells in righteous hearts, deceit perpetually resides within the minds of thieves.

kural:289.label: N
kural:289.meaning: Thieves perish in their perfidy as they know nothing but pilfery.

kural:290.label: N
kural:290.meaning: The body rejects thieves while honest men are received in heaven.

kural:291.label: N
kural:291.meaning: Truth is defined as speaking words completely free from evil.

kural:292.label: N
kural:292.meaning: Even falsehood can be considered truth if it brings faultless good.

kural:293.label: M
kural:293.meaning: Do not lie knowingly in your heart; conscience will scorch you.

kural:294.label: N
kural:294.meaning: He who lives without mental falsehood dwells in the hearts of all.

kural:295.label: N
kural:295.meaning: Speaking truth from the heart is superior to charity and austerity.

kural:296.label: N
kural:296.meaning: Not lying brings praise and yields all forms of virtue.

kural:297.label: N
kural:297.meaning: Practice truth strictly so that you need no other virtue.

kural:298.label: L
kural:298.meaning: Water cleanses the body outwardly while truth cleanses the mind inwardly.

kural:299.label: M
kural:299.meaning: Not all lamps are true lights; the lamp of truth is the real light for the wise.

kural:300.label: N
kural:300.meaning: Among all things seen, nothing is better than truth.

kural:301.label: N
kural:301.meaning: Anger control is necessary against the weak and useless against the strong.

kural:302.label: N
kural:302.meaning: Anger is harmful when powerless and even worse when directed at the meek.

kural:303.label: N
kural:303.meaning: Renounce anger towards everyone because it is the root of pain and sin.

kural:304.label: N
kural:304.meaning: There is no greater enemy than anger which destroys joy and smiles.

kural:305.label: N
kural:305.meaning: Guard yourself against anger; otherwise, that very anger will destroy you.

kural:306.label: N
kural:306.meaning: Anger destroys friends and burns down the protective raft of kinship.

kural:307.label: N
kural:307.meaning: The ruin of an angry person is as certain as a hand striking the ground.

kural:308.label: M
kural:308.meaning: Even if harmed severely like touching fire, it is best not to be angry.

kural:309.label: N
kural:309.meaning: A person who harbors no anger in their mind will achieve all desired goals.

kural:310.label: N
kural:310.meaning: The angry are like the dead, while those who renounce anger equal ascetics.

kural:311.label: N
kural:311.meaning: The code of the pure is to do no harm even for supreme wealth.

kural:312.label: N
kural:312.meaning: The spotless principle is not to retaliate with harm even when injured maliciously.

kural:313.label: N
kural:313.meaning: Harm done to those who did no evil brings inevitable ruin.

kural:314.label: N
kural:314.meaning: Punish evildoers by doing them good to put them to shame.

kural:315.label: N
kural:315.meaning: Wisdom is useless if one does not feel others' pain as their own.

kural:316.label: N
kural:316.meaning: Do not inflict upon others what you recognize as painful to yourself.

kural:317.label: N
kural:317.meaning: Never commit base actions in thought, anywhere, at any time.

kural:318.label: N
kural:318.meaning: How can one who knows the value of life cause harm to others?

kural:319.label: L
kural:319.meaning: If you harm others in the morning, misfortune returns to you by afternoon.

kural:320.label: N
kural:320.meaning: Pains rebound on those who cause them; peace-lovers cause no harm.

kural:321.label: N
kural:321.meaning: Virtue is non-killing, as killing leads to all other evils.

kural:322.label: N
kural:322.meaning: Sharing food and protecting all lives is the greatest ancient law.

kural:323.label: N
kural:323.meaning: Not killing is the highest good, followed closely by truthfulness.

kural:324.label: N
kural:324.meaning: The good path is defined as the way that avoids killing entirely.

kural:326.label: N
kural:326.meaning: Death spares those who do not kill.

kural:327.label: N
kural:327.meaning: Do not take another life even to save your own.

kural:328.label: N
kural:328.meaning: Wealth gained through slaughter is evil.

kural:329.label: N
kural:329.meaning: Killers are despised as low-born carrion-eaters.

kural:330.label: N
kural:330.meaning: Sickly and suffering people are past killers.

kural:331.label: N
kural:331.meaning: Folly to regard transient things as permanent.

kural:332.label: O
kural:332.meaning: Wealth coming and going is like a theatrical assembly.

kural:333.label: N
kural:333.meaning: Wealth is transient; do good deeds immediately.

kural:334.label: O
kural:334.meaning: Days pass like a saw cutting into life.

kural:335.label: O
kural:335.meaning: Do good deeds before tongue benumbs and hiccups start.

kural:336.label: L
kural:336.meaning: The world's nature is that someone is here yesterday and gone today.

kural:337.label: N
kural:337.meaning: Man knows not his next moment, yet plans crores of things.

kural:338.label: O
kural:338.meaning: The soul leaves the body just like a bird leaves its shell.

kural:339.label: O
kural:339.meaning: Death is like sleep and birth is like waking up.

kural:340.label: N
kural:340.meaning: The life residing temporarily in the body lacks a permanent home.

kural:341.label: N
kural:341.meaning: Freedom from attachments brings freedom from suffering.

kural:342.label: N
kural:342.meaning: Renounce to gain true and endless spiritual joys.

kural:343.label: N
kural:343.meaning: Curb the five senses and renounce all desires.

kural:344.label: N
kural:344.meaning: Having nothing is the rule of asceticism; possessions delude.

kural:345.label: N
kural:345.meaning: Even the body is a burden for those seeking liberation.

kural:346.label: N
kural:346.meaning: One who destroys ego attains a world rare for gods.

kural:347.label: N
kural:347.meaning: Grief clings to those who do not let go of attachments.

kural:348.label: N
kural:348.meaning: Those who renounce are free, while others are caught in delusion.

kural:349.label: N
kural:349.meaning: Cutting off worldly attachments ends rebirth and reveals the instability of life.

kural:350.label: N
kural:350.meaning: Cling to the feet of the unbound God to sever all other attachments.

kural:351.label: N
kural:351.meaning: Delusion causes ignoble rebirth by mistaking worthless things for real value.

kural:352.label: N
kural:352.meaning: Spotless insight removes illusion and yields supreme, enduring bliss.

kural:353.label: N
kural:353.meaning: To clear minds free from doubt, heaven is closer and more accessible than earth.

kural:354.label: N
kural:354.meaning: Sensory perception is useless to those who lack inner realization of the Truth.

kural:355.label: N
kural:355.meaning: True wisdom discerns the true nature of any object, whatever its form.

kural:356.label: N
kural:356.meaning: Those who realize the Truth attain the path from which there is no return.

kural:357.label: N
kural:357.meaning: One who deeply contemplates inner truth is permanently freed from the cycle of rebirth.

kural:358.label: N
kural:358.meaning: Wisdom is perceiving the ultimate reality to eradicate the ignorance of birth.

kural:359.label: N
kural:359.meaning: Understand the true refuge and eliminate attachments to prevent recurring spiritual maladies.

kural:360.label: N
kural:360.meaning: All spiritual sufferings perish completely when lust, anger, and delusion are eradicated.

kural:361.label: N
kural:361.meaning: Desire is the seed that causes ceaseless human rebirths.

kural:362.label: N
kural:362.meaning: To prevent rebirth, desire nothing at all.

kural:363.label: N
kural:363.meaning: There is no wealth comparable to freedom from desire.

kural:364.label: N
kural:364.meaning: Purity is the absence of desire, attained through truth.

kural:365.label: N
kural:365.meaning: Only those who are free from desire are truly detached.

kural:366.label: N
kural:366.meaning: Fear desire as the ultimate snare; virtue avoids it.

kural:367.label: N
kural:367.meaning: If you completely destroy desire, liberation naturally follows.

kural:368.label: N
kural:368.meaning: Those without desire have no sorrow; with it, grief multiplies.

kural:369.label: N
kural:369.meaning: Destroy the ultimate woe of desire to experience endless joy.

kural:370.label: N
kural:370.meaning: Casting off insatiable desire brings eternal, unchanging bliss.

kural:371.label: N
kural:371.meaning: Favorable fate brings diligence, while unfavorable fate causes laziness.

kural:372.label: N
kural:372.meaning: Loss-bringing fate causes foolishness, while gain-fate broadens intellect.

kural:373.label: N
kural:373.meaning: Innate wisdom surpasses the value of studying many subtle books.

kural:374.label: N
kural:374.meaning: The world naturally has two kinds of people: the wealthy and the wise.

kural:375.label: N
kural:375.meaning: The pursuit of wealth can make good appear bad and vice versa.

kural:376.label: N
kural:376.meaning: Destined things remain yours, while unassigned things never stay.

kural:377.label: N
kural:377.meaning: Even if millions are amassed, one enjoys only what fate allots.

kural:378.label: N
kural:378.meaning: Destitute people might renounce desire if fate does not afflict them.

kural:379.label: N
kural:379.meaning: Why grieve in evil times if you saw good in good times?

kural:380.label: N
kural:380.meaning: Fate is the most powerful force, preceding any counter-plans.

kural:381.label: N
kural:381.meaning: A king possessing six essential elements stands above other rulers.

kural:382.label: N
kural:382.meaning: Courage, charity, wisdom, and enthusiasm are four essential royal qualities.

kural:383.label: N
kural:383.meaning: Vigilance, learning, and decisiveness are three necessary traits for rulers.

kural:384.label: N
kural:384.meaning: A true king avoids vice, upholds virtue, and acts with brave honor.

kural:385.label: N
kural:385.meaning: An able king acquires, stores, guards and distributes wealth for the people.

kural:386.label: N
kural:386.meaning: The land prospers whose king is accessible and speaks gently.

kural:387.label: N
kural:387.meaning: The world respects and follows the ruler who speaks sweetly and gives generously.

kural:388.label: N
kural:388.meaning: A king who administers justice and protects his subjects is considered a god.

kural:389.label: N
kural:389.meaning: The world rests under the umbrella of a king who tolerates harsh truths.

kural:390.label: M
kural:390.meaning: Bounty, justice, care and grace are the four lights of a king.

kural:391.label: N
kural:391.meaning: Learn flawlessly what is worth learning and live accordingly.

kural:392.label: M
kural:392.meaning: Numbers and letters are regarded as the two eyes of living beings.

kural:393.label: N
kural:393.meaning: Only the learned have eyes; the unlearned have mere sores on their faces.

kural:394.label: N
kural:394.meaning: Meeting with joy and leaving thoughtful is the hallmark of scholars.

kural:395.label: N
kural:395.meaning: The learned yearn for knowledge like paupers before the rich; the unlearned are base.

kural:396.label: O
kural:396.meaning: Water flows from a sandy well as deep as you dig; knowledge grows with learning.

kural:397.label: N
kural:397.meaning: Education should continue throughout life, as all lands and towns belong to the learner.

kural:398.label: N
kural:398.meaning: The knowledge acquired in one birth provides security and excellence across seven births.

kural:399.label: N
kural:399.meaning: The learned desire education further when they see the world enjoying its benefits.

kural:400.label: N
kural:400.meaning: Education is the only indestructible wealth; all other possessions are not true wealth.

kural:401.label: O
kural:401.science_concept: playing a game without a board
kural:401.meaning: Speaking in an assembly without deep learning is like playing a game without a board.

kural:402.label: O
kural:402.meaning: An unlearned man desiring eloquence is like a breastless woman desiring love.

kural:403.label: N
kural:403.meaning: Even unlearned men are considered good if they remain silent before the wise.

kural:404.label: N
kural:404.meaning: The cleverness of an unlearned person, however good, is not valued by the wise.

kural:405.label: N
kural:405.meaning: The worth of an unlearned man collapses when he speaks in public.

kural:406.label: O
kural:406.meaning: Unlearned people merely exist, resembling barren, unproductive lands.

kural:407.label: O
kural:407.meaning: A fine physical appearance without subtle learning is like a beautifully painted clay doll.

kural:408.label: N
kural:408.meaning: Wealth in the hands of fools is more painful than poverty among the learned.

kural:409.label: N
kural:409.meaning: Uneducated persons of high birth are inferior to learned low-born men.

kural:410.label: N
kural:410.meaning: The unlearned are like animals compared to scholars.

kural:411.label: N
kural:411.meaning: The wealth of hearing is the greatest of all wealths.

kural:412.label: N
kural:412.meaning: When the ear lacks food, some food is given to the stomach.

kural:413.label: N
kural:413.meaning: Those rich in hearing wisdom are equal to gods who consume oblations.

kural:414.label: N
kural:414.meaning: Listen even if unlearned; it serves as a supporting staff in times of need.

kural:415.label: N
kural:415.meaning: The words of virtuous men act like a walking stick on slippery ground.

kural:416.label: N
kural:416.meaning: Listen to good words however few, and they will grant you greatness.

kural:417.label: N
kural:417.meaning: Those with deep learning do not speak foolishly even by mistake.

kural:418.label: N
kural:418.meaning: Ears not trained by hearing wisdom are deaf though they hear.

kural:419.label: N
kural:419.meaning: It is rare for those without subtle learning to possess a humble speech.

kural:420.label: N
kural:420.meaning: Those who relish taste by mouth, not ear, what does it matter if they live or die?

kural:421.label: N
kural:421.meaning: Wisdom acts as an impenetrable fortress and a weapon against all enemies.

kural:422.label: N
kural:422.meaning: True wisdom restrains straying senses, wards off evil, and guides towards goodness.

kural:423.label: N
kural:423.meaning: Wisdom is discerning the absolute truth from anything heard, from anyone.

kural:424.label: N
kural:424.meaning: Wisdom speaks clearly and comprehends subtle meanings expressed by others.

kural:425.label: N
kural:425.meaning: The wise befriend the world and remain emotionally balanced without blooming or withering.

kural:426.label: N
kural:426.meaning: True wisdom is adapting oneself to live in harmony with the changing world.

kural:427.label: N
kural:427.meaning: The wise can foresee future events, while the foolish lack this foresight.

kural:428.label: N
kural:428.meaning: Fearing what ought to be feared is wisdom; failing to fear is folly.

kural:429.label: N
kural:429.meaning: The wise who anticipate future troubles are never overwhelmed by sudden calamities.

kural:430.label: N
kural:430.meaning: Those possessing wisdom possess everything, whereas the unwise own nothing despite wealth.

kural:431.label: N
kural:431.meaning: Prosperity belongs to those who are free from arrogance, anger, and pettiness.

kural:432.label: N
kural:432.meaning: Avarice, improper pride, and base joy are flaws that ruin a leader.

kural:433.label: O
kural:433.science_concept: millet seed and palmyra tree size contrast
kural:433.meaning: People ashamed of disgrace treat a millet-sized fault as tall as a palmyra tree.

kural:434.label: N
kural:434.meaning: Guard against faults carefully, for faults are a fatal enemy.

kural:435.label: O
kural:435.meaning: The life of one who fails to guard himself perishes like straw placed before fire.

kural:436.label: N
kural:436.meaning: What fault can touch a king who first corrects his own faults before scanning others?

kural:437.label: N
kural:437.meaning: The wealth of a miser who fails to do rightful deeds will inevitably perish.

kural:438.label: N
kural:438.meaning: The grasping greed of a miser's heart is reckoned the worst of all faults.

kural:439.label: N
kural:439.meaning: Never boast of yourself, and never do deeds that yield no good.

kural:440.label: N
kural:440.meaning: The designs of foes will fail if one carefully conceals his intentions.

kural:441.label: N
kural:441.meaning: Carefully select and cultivate the friendship of wise men who understand virtue.

kural:442.label: N
kural:442.meaning: Cherish skilled men who remove present ills and prevent future ones.

kural:443.label: N
kural:443.meaning: To honour great men and make them one's own is the rarest of rare things.

kural:444.label: N
kural:444.meaning: To walk closely with superiors as one's own is the greatest power of all.

kural:445.label: N
kural:445.meaning: Ministers are the monarch's eyes; the king should choose his counsellors wisely.

kural:446.label: N
kural:446.meaning: A ruler who moves with worthy friends has nothing to fear from foes.

kural:447.label: N
kural:447.meaning: No foe can defeat the king who employs advisers willing to correct him.

kural:448.label: N
kural:448.meaning: A careless king without censuring advisers will ruin himself without external foes.

kural:449.label: N
kural:449.meaning: Just as trade needs capital, life needs reliable companions for stability.

kural:450.label: N
kural:450.meaning: Abandoning good friends is ten times worse than making many enemies.

kural:451.label: N
kural:451.meaning: The noble fear bad company, while the mean naturally befriend them.

kural:452.label: O
kural:452.meaning: Water takes the quality of the soil; human wisdom depends on associates.

kural:453.label: N
kural:453.meaning: Inner perception comes from the mind, but a man's reputation comes from his companions.

kural:454.label: N
kural:454.meaning: Wisdom seems to originate in the mind, but truly flows from one's company.

kural:455.label: N
kural:455.meaning: Pure thoughts and deeds arise from maintaining pure and good company.

kural:456.label: N
kural:456.meaning: Pure-minded people leave good legacy; those with pure company never fail.

kural:457.label: N
kural:457.meaning: Goodness of mind and good company bring prosperity and fame.

kural:458.label: N
kural:458.meaning: Wise men find additional strength in good friendships.

kural:459.label: N
kural:459.meaning: A good mind ensures future bliss, reinforced by good company.

kural:460.label: N
kural:460.meaning: There is no help like good company, and no worse harm than bad.

kural:461.label: N
kural:461.meaning: Calculate loss, gain, and resulting profit before action.

kural:462.label: N
kural:462.meaning: Nothing is difficult for those who act with well-chosen associates.

kural:463.label: N
kural:463.meaning: The wise do not risk their principal capital seeking uncertain gains.

kural:464.label: N
kural:464.meaning: Those who fear disgrace do not begin uncleared ventures.

kural:465.label: N
kural:465.meaning: Acting without thorough planning hands victory to one's enemies.

kural:466.label: N
kural:466.meaning: Doing improper deeds ruins a person, as does omitting proper ones.

kural:467.label: N
kural:467.meaning: Think before acting; to think after daring is a fault.

kural:468.label: N
kural:468.meaning: Unplanned toil will fail despite the support of many.

kural:469.label: N
kural:469.meaning: Even good deeds may fail if not adapted to the recipient's nature.

kural:470.label: N
kural:470.meaning: Perform irreproachable deeds that the world will not reject.

kural:471.label: N
kural:471.meaning: Act after carefully weighing your strength, the enemy's, and allies'.

kural:472.label: N
kural:472.meaning: Nothing is impossible for those who understand their capacity and act wisely.

kural:473.label: N
kural:473.meaning: Many who overestimate their strength fail midway and ruin themselves.

kural:474.label: N
kural:474.meaning: He who lacks adaptability, ignores limits, and is arrogant will quickly perish.

kural:475.label: L
kural:475.science_concept: Load capacity limits and structural failure
kural:475.meaning: Even a cart loaded with light peacock feathers will break its axle if overloaded.

kural:476.label: L
kural:476.science_concept: Weight distribution and branch structural limits
kural:476.meaning: Climbing to the very tip of a tree branch and going further causes death.

kural:477.label: N
kural:477.meaning: Give charity knowing your limits; that is the proper way to guard wealth.

kural:478.label: N
kural:478.meaning: Even if income is small, there is no ruin if expenditure does not exceed it.

kural:479.label: N
kural:479.meaning: He who lives beyond his means will seem prosperous but eventually perish.

kural:480.label: N
kural:480.meaning: Generosity without measuring one's resources leads to rapid ruin.

kural:481.label: L
kural:481.science_concept: animal behavior based on circadian rhythms
kural:481.meaning: Crows defeat owls by day; kings must wait for the right time.

kural:482.label: M
kural:482.meaning: Acting in accordance with the proper season binds fortune securely.

kural:483.label: N
kural:483.meaning: No task is difficult for one who uses proper means and timing.

kural:484.label: N
kural:484.meaning: Even the world can be won if one chooses the right time and place.

kural:485.label: N
kural:485.meaning: Those who aim to conquer the world wait patiently for the right time.

kural:486.label: O
kural:486.meaning: The retreat of the strong is like a ram stepping back to butt.

kural:487.label: N
kural:487.meaning: The wise conceal their anger and wait for the right time to act.

kural:488.label: N
kural:488.meaning: Endure enemies until the fatal time arrives to defeat them.

kural:489.label: N
kural:489.meaning: When a rare and ripe season arrives, execute difficult deeds instantly.

kural:490.label: O
kural:490.meaning: Wait silently like a crane, and strike precisely like its beak.

kural:491.label: N
kural:491.meaning: Do not start any action or despise anyone until you survey the place.

kural:492.label: N
kural:492.meaning: Fortified strongholds provide numerous advantages even to powerful kings.

kural:493.label: N
kural:493.meaning: Strategic defense and careful planning ensure victory over enemies.

kural:494.label: N
kural:494.meaning: Choosing the right battleground defeats the enemy's plans.

kural:495.label: L
kural:495.meaning: A crocodile dominates in deep water but is easily defeated on land.

kural:496.label: L
kural:496.meaning: Chariots cannot run on the sea, and ships cannot sail on land.

kural:497.label: N
kural:497.meaning: Courage and careful tactical planning are the only required supports.

kural:498.label: N
kural:498.meaning: A small force in an advantageous position can crush a well-armed enemy.

kural:499.label: N
kural:499.meaning: It is difficult to defeat opponents fighting on their own native ground.

kural:500.label: L
kural:500.meaning: A fox can kill a brave war elephant trapped in deep mud.

kural:501.label: N
kural:501.meaning: Test men through virtue, wealth, joy, and fear before trusting them.

kural:502.label: N
kural:502.meaning: Choose individuals from noble families who avoid faults and fear disgrace.

kural:503.label: N
kural:503.meaning: Even among learned scholars, some minor flaws or ignorance can be found.

kural:504.label: N
kural:504.meaning: Weigh both virtues and faults, then judge a person by which prevails.

kural:505.label: O
kural:505.meaning: Touchstone is used to test the quality of gold and deeds.

kural:506.label: N
kural:506.meaning: Avoid choosing people who lack kinsmen and shame.

kural:507.label: N
kural:507.meaning: Choosing ignorant people based on affection brings total folly.

kural:508.label: N
kural:508.meaning: Trusting an untested stranger brings endless troubles.

kural:509.label: N
kural:509.meaning: Do not trust blindly; test first and then employ.

kural:510.label: N
kural:510.meaning: Untested trust and doubting the tested both cause endless trouble.

kural:511.label: N
kural:511.meaning: Employ those who discern good and bad and love virtue.

kural:512.label: N
kural:512.meaning: Assign tasks to those who increase wealth and analyze problems.

kural:513.label: N
kural:513.meaning: Trust him who possesses love, wisdom, certainty, and freedom from desire.

kural:514.label: N
kural:514.meaning: Though tested, many people change when given actual work.

kural:515.label: N
kural:515.meaning: Assign tasks only to capable men through rigorous testing.

kural:516.label: N
kural:516.meaning: Consider the worker, the deed, and the proper time to act.

kural:517.label: N
kural:517.meaning: Assign tasks after carefully examining the person's capability and the method.

kural:518.label: N
kural:518.meaning: Once the suitability for a task is examined, employ them appropriately.

kural:519.label: N
kural:519.meaning: Prosperity leaves those who doubt the loyalty of capable workers.

kural:520.label: N
kural:520.meaning: If the king ensures officials act righteously, the world remains righteous.

kural:521.label: N
kural:521.meaning: True kinsmen cherish ancient ties even when wealth disappears.

kural:522.label: N
kural:522.meaning: Having loving kinsmen brings unfailing and abundant prosperity.

kural:523.label: O
kural:523.meaning: Life without close kinsmen is like a tank without banks filled with water.

kural:524.label: N
kural:524.meaning: The true benefit of gaining wealth is living surrounded by supportive kinsmen.

kural:525.label: N
kural:525.meaning: Generosity and pleasant words attract a large circle of kinsmen.

kural:526.label: N
kural:526.meaning: A generous, wrathless person has no equal supporters on earth.

kural:527.label: O
kural:527.meaning: Crows call others and share food without hiding; such wealth belongs to the sharing.

kural:528.label: N
kural:528.meaning: When a king observes all impartially according to merit, many will flourish.

kural:529.label: N
kural:529.meaning: Forsaken friends will return when the cause for discord goes away.

kural:530.label: N
kural:530.meaning: A king should carefully test and receive someone who left and returns.

kural:531.label: N
kural:531.meaning: Excessive forgetfulness in joy is worse than excessive anger.

kural:532.label: N
kural:532.meaning: Negligence kills renown just as ceaseless want destroys wisdom.

kural:533.label: N
kural:533.meaning: The forgetful fail to gain fame, as all schools of thought agree.

kural:534.label: N
kural:534.meaning: The fearful find no fortress, and the forgetful find no goodness.

kural:535.label: N
kural:535.meaning: Failing to foresee and guard, a careless man will later rue his folly.

kural:536.label: N
kural:536.meaning: Watch with wakeful care and miss nothing; such vigilance is unmatched.

kural:537.label: N
kural:537.meaning: With cautious and vigilant care, nothing is impossible to achieve.

kural:538.label: N
kural:538.meaning: Do what the wise commend, or suffer misfortune for seven births.

kural:539.label: N
kural:539.meaning: When joy deludes you, recall the fate of those ruined by negligence.

kural:540.label: N
kural:540.meaning: It is easy to attain a goal when the mind is constantly set on it.

kural:541.label: N
kural:541.meaning: Justice and impartial testing are the foundations of governance.

kural:542.label: O
kural:542.meaning: The world depends on rain to live, just as subjects depend on the king's justice.

kural:543.label: N
kural:543.meaning: The king's sceptre is the source of scripture and virtue.

kural:544.label: N
kural:544.meaning: The world clings to the feet of the just ruler.

kural:545.label: L
kural:545.meaning: A righteous king's land is blessed with abundant rain and harvest.

kural:546.label: N
kural:546.meaning: A straight sceptre, not a spear, brings victory to a monarch.

kural:547.label: N
kural:547.meaning: The king protects the earth, and flawless justice protects the king.

kural:548.label: N
kural:548.meaning: An unjust king who fails to administer fair justice will ruin himself.

kural:549.label: N
kural:549.meaning: Protecting subjects and punishing crime is the righteous duty of a king.

kural:550.label: O
kural:550.meaning: Punishing criminals is like a farmer weeding a crop field to protect yields.

kural:551.label: N
kural:551.meaning: An oppressive tyrant is worse than a cruel murderer.

kural:552.label: N
kural:552.meaning: An unjust king demanding wealth is like a robber demanding ransom with a spear.

kural:553.label: N
kural:553.meaning: A king who fails to investigate and dispense justice daily will see his realm decay.

kural:554.label: N
kural:554.meaning: An unjust king who acts without thought will lose both his wealth and subjects.

kural:555.label: O
kural:555.science_concept: tears eroding wealth like a file
kural:555.meaning: Tears from oppressed subjects act like a weapon that destroys the ruler's wealth.

kural:556.label: M
kural:556.meaning: A king endures only through righteous governance; without it, royal glory fades.

kural:557.label: L
kural:557.meaning: Just as lack of rain ruins the earth, a graceless king harms all living creatures.

kural:558.label: N
kural:558.meaning: Possessions become a curse rather than a blessing under the rule of an unjust king.

kural:559.label: L
kural:559.science_concept: correlation between royal governance and rainfall
kural:559.meaning: If a king acts unjustly, the heavens fail to pour seasonal rain.

kural:560.label: L
kural:560.science_concept: decline in cattle yield due to lack of protection
kural:560.meaning: If the ruler fails to protect, cows yield less and sages forget their learning.

kural:561.label: N
kural:561.meaning: A king must investigate properly and punish appropriately to prevent future offenses.

kural:562.label: N
kural:562.meaning: Raise the rod high but strike gently if you desire long-lasting prosperity.

kural:563.label: N
kural:563.meaning: A cruel ruler who inspires terror will certainly and quickly perish.

kural:564.label: N
kural:564.meaning: A king reviled by his people as a tyrant will quickly meet his downfall.

kural:565.label: N
kural:565.meaning: Wealth acquired by a cruel and unpleasant person resembles wealth guarded by a ghoul.

kural:566.label: N
kural:566.meaning: The immense wealth of a harsh and uncompassionate ruler will swiftly perish.

kural:567.label: O
kural:567.meaning: Harsh words and excessive punishments act like a file that erodes a king's power.

kural:568.label: N
kural:568.meaning: A king who fails to consult advisors and rules with anger will lose his fortune.

kural:569.label: N
kural:569.meaning: A king who fails to build fortifications before war will perish in terror.

kural:570.label: M
kural:570.meaning: A cruel sceptre binding fools is the only burden that the earth bears.

kural:571.label: N
kural:571.meaning: The world continues to exist because of the great quality of gracious consideration.

kural:572.label: M
kural:572.meaning: The world runs on sympathetic looks; those lacking them are merely a burden to earth.

kural:573.label: N
kural:573.meaning: What use is a song without melody, or eyes without the grace of compassion?

kural:574.label: N
kural:574.meaning: What do eyes without graceful consideration do, except sit on the face like decorations?

kural:575.label: N
kural:575.meaning: The ornament of the eye is compassionate sight; without it, eyes are perceived as wounds.

kural:576.label: O
kural:576.meaning: Those lacking compassion are like lifeless trees rooted in the earth.

kural:577.label: N
kural:577.meaning: Graciousness is compared to having eyes; true vision is inseparable from grace.

kural:578.label: N
kural:578.meaning: Those who combine grace with duty have rightful claim to this world.

kural:579.label: N
kural:579.meaning: The highest virtue is showing grace and enduring even the harms of enemies.

kural:580.label: N
kural:580.meaning: Lovers of social courtesy will cheerfully swallow poison if required.

kural:581.label: N
kural:581.meaning: A king should regard spies and the code of laws as his two eyes.

kural:582.label: N
kural:582.meaning: A king's duty is to know fully all events that happen to everyone always.

kural:583.label: N
kural:583.meaning: A king who fails to verify spy reports cannot attain lasting victory.

kural:584.label: N
kural:584.meaning: Spies must investigate officials, relatives, and enemies alike.

kural:585.label: N
kural:585.meaning: A spy must maintain an unsuspected guise and remain fearless.

kural:586.label: N
kural:586.meaning: Disguised as ascetics, spies gather facts without faltering under threat.

kural:587.label: N
kural:587.meaning: A competent spy extracts hidden secrets and clarifies facts beyond doubt.

kural:588.label: N
kural:588.meaning: Information brought by one spy should be verified by another independent spy.

kural:589.label: N
kural:589.meaning: Engage spies individually and confirm their reports through three independent sources.

kural:590.label: N
kural:590.meaning: Do not reward spies openly, or you will reveal the secret.

kural:591.label: N
kural:591.meaning: True possession is mental energy; those without it possess nothing.

kural:592.label: N
kural:592.meaning: Mental resolve is true wealth, while material wealth quickly vanishes.

kural:593.label: N
kural:593.meaning: Those possessing firm willpower do not despair over lost wealth.

kural:594.label: N
kural:594.meaning: Fortune seeks out and stays with those of unwavering energy.

kural:595.label: O
kural:595.science_concept: lotus stem length correlates with water depth
kural:595.meaning: Lotus stem length matches water depth, as human greatness matches mental resolve.

kural:596.label: N
kural:596.meaning: Always aspire for great things; even if unattained, the aspiration is valuable.

kural:597.label: O
kural:597.meaning: Elephants stand firm pierced by arrows, as great minds endure defeat.

kural:598.label: N
kural:598.meaning: Spiritless people cannot experience the pride of charitable giving.

kural:599.label: O
kural:599.meaning: Huge armed elephants cower when attacked by a smaller tiger.

kural:600.label: M
kural:600.meaning: Mental courage is true wealth; lacking it, men are merely trees.

kural:601.label: M
kural:601.meaning: The lamp of ancestry is extinguished by the darkness of laziness.

kural:602.label: N
kural:602.meaning: Those who desire a prosperous home must strictly avoid idleness.

kural:603.label: N
kural:603.meaning: The foolish person who cherishes sloth ruins his lineage before dying.

kural:604.label: N
kural:604.meaning: Sloth leads to failure and accumulating faults, destroying one's family lineage.

kural:605.label: M
kural:605.meaning: Procrastination, forgetfulness, idleness, and sleep are boats carrying one to ruin.

kural:606.label: N
kural:606.meaning: Even with great worldly support, the slothful never attain true noble rewards.

kural:607.label: N
kural:607.meaning: The slothful who lack noble effort will inevitably hear scornful words.

kural:608.label: N
kural:608.meaning: If sloth enters a noble family, it reduces them to servitude.

kural:609.label: N
kural:609.meaning: Family flaws and degradation vanish when one abandons laziness.

kural:610.label: A
kural:610.science_concept: all-encompassing cosmic space measured by divine feet
kural:610.meaning: The industrious king shall conquer and rule all the vast regions measured by Vishnu.

kural:611.label: N
kural:611.meaning: Do not despair thinking a task is too hard; perseverance brings greatness.

kural:612.label: N
kural:612.meaning: Do not fail in tasks; society abandons those who fail to work.

kural:613.label: N
kural:613.meaning: Excellence of industry leads to magnanimous bounty and social duty.

kural:614.label: M
kural:614.meaning: Bounty without industry is useless like a sword in a eunuch's hand.

kural:615.label: M
kural:615.meaning: One who prefers work over pleasure acts as a pillar supporting friends.

kural:616.label: N
kural:616.meaning: Industry brings prosperity while indolence causes poverty.

kural:617.label: M
kural:617.meaning: Misfortune stays with the lazy, while prosperity stays with the hardworking.

kural:618.label: N
kural:618.meaning: Lack of fortune is not blameworthy; failure to apply effort is.

kural:619.label: N
kural:619.meaning: Even if fate fails, physical labor will eventually provide its due reward.

kural:620.label: N
kural:620.meaning: Tireless workers can overcome even predetermined fate.

kural:621.label: N
kural:621.meaning: Greet troubles with a smile to effectively conquer and overcome them.

kural:622.label: O
kural:622.meaning: Deluge-like sorrows vanish when wise men confront them with firm resolve.

kural:623.label: N
kural:623.meaning: Those who do not despair put grief itself to grief.

kural:624.label: O
kural:624.meaning: Enduring hardships like a patient ox makes trouble itself suffer.

kural:625.label: N
kural:625.meaning: The steadfast person overcomes grief itself by facing hardships bravely.

kural:626.label: N
kural:626.meaning: The wise do not grieve over loss, nor do they excessively celebrate gain.

kural:627.label: N
kural:627.meaning: The wise do not panic, knowing the human body is prone to sorrows.

kural:628.label: N
kural:628.meaning: One who accepts grief as a natural state does not suffer from it.

kural:629.label: N
kural:629.meaning: One who does not cling to pleasures does not suffer when grief strikes.

kural:630.label: N
kural:630.meaning: Even foes respect the person who considers hardship as a source of good.

kural:631.label: N
kural:631.meaning: A true minister masters tools, time, action, and difficult undertakings.

kural:632.label: N
kural:632.meaning: A minister protects citizens through learning, firmness, and diligent effort.

kural:633.label: N
kural:633.meaning: A skilled minister divides enemies, cherishes allies, and reunites the separated.

kural:634.label: N
kural:634.meaning: A minister analyzes, executes correctly, and speaks with absolute conviction.

kural:635.label: N
kural:635.meaning: Choose an adviser who knows virtue and speaks wisely in any situation.

kural:636.label: N
kural:636.meaning: What obstacle can withstand a sharp intellect combined with scriptural knowledge?

kural:637.label: N
kural:637.meaning: Act with an understanding of worldly realities even when you know book knowledge.

kural:638.label: N
kural:638.meaning: The minister must state the truth even if the king ignores it.

kural:639.label: N
kural:639.meaning: Seventy crores of enemies are better than a traitorous minister.

kural:640.label: N
kural:640.meaning: Incompetent persons fail to finish tasks despite careful planning.

kural:641.label: N
kural:641.meaning: The eloquence of speech is a supreme and incomparable virtue.

kural:642.label: N
kural:642.meaning: Carefully guard against verbal slips since speech brings wealth or ruin.

kural:643.label: N
kural:643.meaning: Good speech captivates listeners and attracts even indifferent people.

kural:644.label: N
kural:644.meaning: Weigh your words carefully as speech yields both virtue and wealth.

kural:645.label: N
kural:645.meaning: Speak words that cannot be defeated by any counter-argument.

kural:646.label: N
kural:646.meaning: Wise men speak pleasingly and appreciate the value of others' words.

kural:647.label: N
kural:647.meaning: An eloquent, fearless, and tireless speaker is impossible to defeat.

kural:648.label: N
kural:648.meaning: The world executes the commands of eloquent and wise speakers swiftly.

kural:649.label: N
kural:649.meaning: Those who cannot speak flawless words desire to speak too much.

kural:650.label: O
kural:650.meaning: Those who cannot explain learning are like flowers that grow in bunches but lack fragrance.

kural:651.label: N
kural:651.meaning: Friendship brings prosperity, and right action yields all desired benefits.

kural:652.label: N
kural:652.meaning: Always avoid actions that do not yield virtue and fame.

kural:653.label: N
kural:653.meaning: Those seeking greatness must shun deeds that dim their glory.

kural:654.label: N
kural:654.meaning: The steadfast wise do not commit shameful deeds even in deep distress.

kural:655.label: N
kural:655.meaning: Do not do what causes regret; if done, it is best not to repeat it.

kural:656.label: N
kural:656.meaning: Even to feed a starving mother, avoid acts condemned by the wise.

kural:657.label: N
kural:657.meaning: Noble poverty is far better than wealth acquired through wrongful deeds.

kural:658.label: N
kural:658.meaning: Forbidden deeds committed despite warnings will bring trouble even if successful.

kural:659.label: N
kural:659.meaning: Wealth gathered through causing tears vanishes in tears; righteous losses eventually bear good fruit.

kural:660.label: O
kural:660.meaning: Accumulating wealth through deceit is like pouring water into an unbaked clay pot.

kural:661.label: N
kural:661.meaning: Mental resolve is true strength; all other strengths are insignificant.

kural:662.label: N
kural:662.meaning: Avoiding pitfalls and persevering despite setbacks are the twin maxims of the wise.

kural:663.label: N
kural:663.meaning: Completing a task before revealing it brings success; premature display brings ruin.

kural:664.label: N
kural:664.meaning: Speaking words is easy for anyone, but executing them is difficult.

kural:665.label: N
kural:665.meaning: The resolute actions of capable people are recognized and valued by kings.

kural:666.label: N
kural:666.meaning: Those who resolve with a firm mind will achieve their desired goals.

kural:667.label: O
kural:667.science_concept: linchpin holding a large chariot wheel
kural:667.meaning: Do not judge by appearance; the world contains men vital like a chariot linchpin.

kural:668.label: N
kural:668.meaning: Execute chosen tasks without confusion, wavering, or laziness.

kural:669.label: N
kural:669.meaning: Execute with firm resolve tasks that bring ultimate happiness, even if pain besets you.

kural:670.label: N
kural:670.meaning: Even with other strengths, the world disregards those lacking resolute action.

kural:671.label: N
kural:671.meaning: Deliberation should lead to a firm decision; lingering in delay is harmful.

kural:672.label: N
kural:672.meaning: Ponder tasks that require deliberation, but do not delay actions that need immediate execution.

kural:673.label: N
kural:673.meaning: Act when feasible; otherwise, see what is possible and proceed accordingly.

kural:674.label: O
kural:674.meaning: Unfinished work or remaining foes flare up and destroy like an unextinguished fire.

kural:675.label: N
kural:675.meaning: Analyze money, means, time, place, and deed thoroughly before proceeding.

kural:676.label: N
kural:676.meaning: Weigh the final outcome, potential hindrances, and expected profit before acting.

kural:677.label: N
kural:677.meaning: Consult experts to understand the inner secrets of successful action.

kural:678.label: O
kural:678.science_concept: capturing an elephant with an elephant
kural:678.meaning: Accomplish a deed using another deed, just like catching an elephant with an elephant.

kural:679.label: N
kural:679.meaning: Winning over enemies is more urgent than doing good to friends.

kural:680.label: N
kural:680.meaning: Small states submit to powerful foes out of fear of public destruction.

kural:681.label: N
kural:681.meaning: Love, noble birth, and pleasing courtesy are essential traits for an ambassador.

kural:682.label: N
kural:682.meaning: Envoys must possess love, knowledge, and well-researched eloquence.

kural:683.label: N
kural:683.meaning: An envoy should be a scholar among scholars and speak victoriously before armed kings.

kural:684.label: N
kural:684.meaning: One equipped with good form, intelligence, and learning should act as an ambassador.

kural:685.label: N
kural:685.meaning: An envoy should speak concise, pleasant words that yield good results.

kural:686.label: N
kural:686.meaning: A capable envoy is well-learned, fearless, and knows how to speak timely.

kural:687.label: N
kural:687.meaning: An elite speaker understands duty, opportune time, place, and careful thought.

kural:688.label: N
kural:688.meaning: Purity, helpfulness, and boldness are the three essential virtues of an envoy.

kural:689.label: N
kural:689.meaning: An envoy delivering royal messages speaks flawlessly with a courageous heart.

kural:690.label: N
kural:690.meaning: Even facing death, an envoy must unflinchingly secure his king's welfare.

kural:691.label: O
kural:691.science_concept: Heat dissipation with distance from fire
kural:691.meaning: Approach hostile kings like warming oneself by fire: neither too close nor too far.

kural:692.label: N
kural:692.meaning: Not craving what kings desire brings lasting prosperity from them.

kural:693.label: N
kural:693.meaning: Guard against faults carefully, for winning trust back after suspicion is difficult.

kural:694.label: N
kural:694.meaning: Avoid whispering and exchanging smiles in the presence of noble elders.

kural:695.label: N
kural:695.meaning: Do not pry into unrevealed matters; listen to secrets only when disclosed.

kural:696.label: N
kural:696.meaning: Discern the king's mood, time, and speak pleasing words without causing aversion.

kural:697.label: N
kural:697.meaning: Advice on speaking pleasing words and avoiding futile speech.

kural:698.label: N
kural:698.meaning: Treat leaders with respect regardless of age or relation.

kural:699.label: N
kural:699.meaning: Wise people do not commit base acts due to royal favor.

kural:700.label: N
kural:700.meaning: Abusing old friendships to do wrong brings ruin.

kural:701.label: O
kural:701.meaning: One who reads minds adorns the changeless sea-girt world.

kural:702.label: N
kural:702.meaning: One who accurately intuits thoughts is comparable to a god.

kural:703.label: N
kural:703.meaning: Secure the services of those who can read signs.

kural:704.label: N
kural:704.meaning: Those who divine unspoken thoughts differ fundamentally from others.

kural:705.label: N
kural:705.meaning: What is the use of eyes if one cannot read thoughts?

kural:706.label: O
kural:706.meaning: The face reflects inner thoughts just as a crystal reflects nearby objects.

kural:707.label: N
kural:707.meaning: The face instantly shows whether the mind is happy or angry.

kural:708.label: N
kural:708.meaning: Standing face to face is enough for those who read minds.

kural:709.label: N
kural:709.meaning: Eyes reveal friendship or enmity to those who understand their expressions.

kural:710.label: N
kural:710.meaning: The only measuring instrument for discerning minds is the eye itself.

kural:711.label: N
kural:711.meaning: The eloquent and pure should speak tailoring their words to the audience.

kural:712.label: N
kural:712.meaning: Those skilled in speech delivery must choose words suited to the time.

kural:713.label: N
kural:713.meaning: Ignorant speakers addressing assemblies without knowing speech rules possess no real capability.

kural:714.label: N
kural:714.meaning: Be brilliant before the bright; adopt white lime hue before pale ones.

kural:715.label: N
kural:715.meaning: Modest restraint of not speaking first before elders excels all other virtues.

kural:716.label: N
kural:716.meaning: Faltering before wise scholars is like slipping from the path of righteousness.

kural:717.label: N
kural:717.meaning: Scholarship shines brightest when evaluated by flawless, learned experts.

kural:718.label: O
kural:718.meaning: Speaking to the wise is like pouring water on beds of growing crops.

kural:719.label: N
kural:719.meaning: Never speak thoughtlessly before foolish assemblies, even by mistake.

kural:720.label: N
kural:720.meaning: Speaking wise words before hostile unappreciative people is like pouring ambrosia into gutters.

kural:721.label: N
kural:721.meaning: Pure speakers do not err in conveying words before a council.

kural:722.label: N
kural:722.meaning: A true scholar is one who can eloquently present learning to scholars.

kural:723.label: N
kural:723.meaning: Many can die fighting foes, but few dare stand fearless in councils.

kural:724.label: N
kural:724.meaning: Impress learned men with your lore and gain wisdom from greater savants.

kural:725.label: N
kural:725.meaning: Learn the proper bounds of knowledge to boldly answer assemblies.

kural:726.label: N
kural:726.meaning: Books are useless to those who fear intellectual assemblies.

kural:727.label: N
kural:727.meaning: A coward's learning is like a sharp sword held by an eunuch.
